mentions.name: Rallies
mentions.description: An AI investment assistant backed by real-time market data. Unlike ChatGPT and Perplexity finance, which rely only on web search data, it runs an agent with access to nearly every available stock market data point before answering, and generates charts in between answer snippets to serve visual investors.
mentions.problem: Existing AI assistants like ChatGPT and Perplexity finance are based only on web search data, which is a big limitation in finance where real-time data is important.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on building an investment assistant backed by real time data. ChatGPT and Perplexity finance are amazing, but all of them are based on web search data only, which is a big limitation in finance since realtime data is important.

mentions.name: Rallies
mentions.description: This AI-powered app combines a ChatGPT-style assistant with real-time stock market data for investment analysis, addressing the problem that ChatGPT's investment answers rely on web search and are often dated.
mentions.problem: Over 70% of investors use ChatGPT for investment analysis, but its data is quite dated since it is based on web search; this project provides real-time stock market data instead.
mentions.audience: Investors who use ChatGPT for investment analysis.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on building a chatgpt wrapper with real time stock market data. More than 70% investors are using Chatgpt for their investment analysis these days, but the data is quite dated since it's all based on web search. Trying to fix it.
